// A complete vector path: zero or more contours plus the fill rule that
// decides its interior. The canonical exchange type for 2D outlines.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vector_graphics)
type Path2D
    implements IValue
{
    Contours: Array<Contour2D>;
    FillRule: FillRule;
}
